name: Spellslinger
description: Cheap instants and sorceries in blue and red, with wizards that grow, burn or draw a card every time you cast one. Copy your favourite spells and get them back from the graveyard.

cards.name: Vessa Quillfire, Storm Scholar
cards.rule_text:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Tobren of the Echo Tower
cards.rule_text:
Prowess
Whenever you cast your second instant or sorcery spell each turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Cinder Novice
cards.rule_text: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
cards.flavor_text: Most of her notes are already on fire.

cards.name: Tidecall Adept
cards.rule_text: Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Chalkdust Savant
cards.rule_text: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

cards.name: Twinned Cadence
cards.rule_text:
Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Galeforge Drake
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you scry 1.

cards.name: Kindling Conjurer
cards.rule_text: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 1/1 red Elemental creature token.

cards.name: Ashpage Archivist
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Study of Sparks
cards.rule_text:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.
At the beginning of your end step, if you've cast three or more spells this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Midnight Revision
cards.rule_text: Draw a card. If you've cast another instant or sorcery spell this turn, draw two cards instead.
cards.flavor_text: One more page, then sleep. One more page…

cards.name: Ember Flick
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you've cast another instant or sorcery spell this turn, it deals 3 damage instead.

cards.name: Quiet the Chorus
cards.rule_text:
Counter target spell with mana value 3 or less.
Scry 1.
cards.flavor_text: Not every spell deserves to be finished.

cards.name: Restless Rewrite
cards.rule_text: Discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards plus one.

cards.name: Spellwright's Inkwell
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add two mana in any combination of {U} and/or {R}. Spend this mana only to cast instant or sorcery spells.

cards.name: Lantern of Twin Flames
cards.rule_text: {3}, {T}: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Library Inferno
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
cards.flavor_text: Years of study, let out all at once.

cards.name: Scrollwing Dragon
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, CARDNAME deals 2 damage to each opponent.

cards.name: Lecture Hall Ruins
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
{T}: Add {U} or {R}.
{2}{U}{R}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.flavor_text: The lessons still echo, even without a roof.
